source_commit_note: Hand-maintained from the analyzer and deployer source named in each row. Re-check the row when the source changes.

statuses.supported: Recognized by the analyzer and covered by a test in the repository.
statuses.partial: Recognized in some forms only, or tested for some kinds only.
statuses.not_supported: Not recognized. The analyzer reports it or skips it. Treat it as a manual step.
statuses.not_verified: No test in the repository. Do not rely on it until one exists.

rows.item: net/http ServeMux (HandleFunc with method and path pattern)
rows.evidence: Route patterns such as POST /v1/orders are read into the lockfile.
Fixed in the release that added route tests; before that the route was missing from the lockfile.
Matched by method name when the package path contains chi.
Gin uses uppercase method names, which the matcher does not handle. Its routes do not appear in the ingress table.
Routes are not recognized.
Routes are not recognized.
Methods are set by chaining .Methods(); no test covers it.

rows.item: PostgreSQL via database/sql (postgres driver) or pgxpool
rows.evidence: Tested end to end for deploy. The DSN source is recorded in the lockfile.
Recognized by driver name. Only PostgreSQL is tested for deploy.
Native systemd Redis with a password. Tested end to end.

rows.item: RabbitMQ, MinIO, memcached, ScyllaDB, Temporal, ClickHouse client, MongoDB, Kafka writer
rows.evidence: Recognized by client constructor. Container runtime is not yet tested for these kinds.
Creates a service-to-service binding in the lockfile. No deploy test.

rows.item: Outbound HTTP (URL from config plus route path)
rows.evidence: Binds to the serving service or an egress rule. No end-to-end test.

rows.item: Environment variable via os.Getenv or os.LookupEnv
rows.evidence: Traced back to the variable name, including through a project function that takes it as its first argument.

rows.item: Config struct loaded from a literal .json path (os.ReadFile, os.Open)
rows.evidence: config_file and config_key are recorded. Deploy tests the handoff.
Not traced. A connection string read this way falls back to a default, such as SERVICE_DB_URL.

rows.item: Viper, koanf, or other config libraries
rows.evidence: Not traced. Connection settings loaded this way are not bound.
Out of scope. Keys are recorded, but deploy writes JSON only.

rows.item: Config loaded by reflection or built-up names
rows.evidence: Not resolved.

rows.item: GORM, XORM, Pop, ent (connections opened inside a dependency)
rows.evidence: The analyzer reports the connection as a diagnostic. It is not bound to a store.

rows.item: Commands registered indirectly through a command framework
rows.evidence: Connections in those functions are not reported. A missing binding means not verified, not absent.

rows.item: .sql files in migrations/<service>/ or a root migrations/
rows.evidence: Database is marked auto_provision when migration files exist.
anode migrate runs them. docs/supported-profile.md says deploy does not run migrations; check the command before deploy.

rows.item: One main package, Go HTTP service owned by the developer
rows.evidence: In scope.
Out of scope.
Deploy builds with CGO_ENABLED=0. Code that needs cgo does not build for the target.
No test in the repository covers it.

rows.item: Large third-party projects with their own configuration loaders
rows.evidence: Out of scope.

rows.item: One Linux host (VPS or VM) with systemd and Caddy
rows.evidence: Tested on GCE and OrbStack.
The command exists. No benchmark or failure test.
Refused for services. Only stores can run in containers.
